name: They Won't Believe You
author: Sam
bootlegger: The Hermit might have the Drunk ability, the Lunatic ability, or both at any given time, and which of these is true can change at any time. The Demon learns whenever the Hermit gains the Lunatic's ability.
The Marionette can neighbor a player who registers as the Demon due to the Recluse ability, even if they enter play late due to the Summoner.
If the Summoner turns a player into the Lil' Monsta, the Storyteller chooses an out-of-play Minion for that player to become.
